hints.title: Operator Bisection Splitting
hints.text: Every operator in the expression can serve as the final operation performed. Splitting at operator index splits the problem into independent left and right subexpressions.

hints.title: Subexpression Cartesian Combination
hints.text: For each operator, recursively compute all possible evaluation outcomes of the left side and right side, then combine each pair using that operator.

hints.title: Base Case String Parsing
hints.text: If the string contains no operators, convert it directly to an integer and return as a single-element list. Cache subproblem results to avoid repeated evaluations.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of operators (Catalan number growth)
complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving Catalan complexity time and space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing overlapping subexpression trees without caching does duplicate evaluations for common subranges.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Interval memoization caches subexpression results, bounding compute to unique substring slices.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize Catalan structure and implement clean divide-and-conquer on operator boundaries.
